question: How does the supreme I-consciousness relate to all beings and the universe?
premises: The supreme I-consciousness devours the mass of bound souls from Ananta to Brahmā.
It brings the moving and unmoving world into the cave of its own belly.
Thus all beings and worlds are contained within it.
inference: The supreme I-consciousness encompasses and reabsorbs the entire range of beings and the whole universe within itself.
plain_english: It devours the whole mass of bound souls from Ananta to Brahmā and draws the entire moving and unmoving world into the cave of its own belly.
